title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3130 Grants Lake Boulevard in Sugar Land, Texas, as the "LCpl Garrett W. Gamble, USMC Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3130 Grants Lake Boulevard in Sugar Land, Texas, as the "LCpl Garrett W. Gamble, USMC Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A 2016 law renamed a Sugar Land, Texas post office after a Marine lance corporal, Garrett W. Gamble.
summary.what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service building at 3130 Grants Lake Boulevard in Sugar Land, Texas, the "LCpl Garrett W. Gamble, USMC Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
